title: Parts Velocity report still lists an inactive part's sales
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PVKEEP-01) is tracked at {Location-A}.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-A} (for example P2-89) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL PVKEEP Customer) was invoiced today and sold 2 of {Part-A}.
  • The Parts Velocity row for {Part-A}, for a date range that includes today, read while {Part-A} was active, is {Figures-A} (for example quantity 2).
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after that reading.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Reports → Parts Velocity with the same date range.
  2. Search {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} is listed and its figures equal {Figures-A} (quantity 2).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-E11, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows the report. Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
